about: Rulesets the balance tool knows. changes: a changes.lua (path relative to this file; default the mod's own); options: "vanilla", "defaults" (the mod's mod.json defaults) or {key: bool} over those defaults (a section the mod.json doesn't list is on unless set false here); rules: what the dump can't show (startShare: share of commander storage an army starts with; the game gives 0.5).
